title: Changes
sourcePrompt: Choose a Git repository to see its commits and PR descriptions. An ontology is optional.
sourceUnavailable: Cannot read this repository, or its folder permission expired. Choose it again; your dates are kept.
noHistory: This folder has no Git commits to read. Choose another repository, or try again after the first commit.
loading: Reading commits for this repository and period…
readError: Could not read the Git history. Your repository and dates are kept; try again.
empty: No commits were found in this period. Choose another period.
evidenceReady: Commits are ready. Read them, or create a summary.
scope: Commits on the branch your work merges into (first-parent) in the dates shown, in local time. Commits inside merged branches are not counted separately; uncommitted changes are excluded.
partialHistory: Part of the Git history could not be read within the limit. Counts cover only what was read; narrow the dates to read more.
prTransfer: This sends {repository} and the selected commit hashes or PR numbers to GitHub. Commit messages and file contents are not sent.
prNotRequested: PR descriptions have not been read yet. You can summarize the commit messages alone, or read PR descriptions first.
prUnsupported: PR reading supports public github.com repositories only. Commit messages are still available.
prRefreshFailed: Could not refresh PR descriptions. The ones read earlier and your summary are kept, but they are not up to date. Try again when ready.
prRateLimited: GitHub is limiting PR requests for now. Commit messages are still available.
prRetryAt: GitHub asks you to retry after {time}. Atlas will not retry automatically.
prRetryUnknown: GitHub did not provide a usable retry time. Try again later.
prUnavailable: Could not read these PR descriptions. Access, network or rate limits may be the cause. Commit messages are still available; try again.
noPr: No merged PR was found for the commits checked. This does not mean the repository has no PRs.
prPartial: PR lookup did not finish. Only the descriptions read so far are available; some commits were not checked.
prUnlinked: This PR could not be matched to the selected commits. Its description is left out of the summary.
commitOnlyNote: Commit messages may omit reasons, checks and limits.
transfer: {model} at {destination} receives the commit messages and matched PR descriptions shown in the preview, their commit hashes and PR numbers, and the period. Code and ontology documents are not sent.
packet: Sends {commits} commits and {prs} PR descriptions · {bytes} bytes.
modelUnavailable: No text model is connected. Check Models in Settings, or keep reading the commits and PRs.
modelLimit: This model cannot take this much text. Narrow the dates or choose another connected model.
cancelled: Stopped. Your dates are kept. Text already sent to the model cannot be recalled.
analysisFailed: The model did not return a summary. Your dates are kept; try again.
invalidAnalysis: The summary did not match the commits and PRs it cites. Read them directly or try again.
noExplanation: These descriptions do not say enough for a useful summary. Read them directly or choose another period.
auditFailed: The transfer log could not be written, so this result is not shown. The request may already have been sent. Check disk space and access to the log folder before trying again.
stale: The repository or PR descriptions changed. Refresh before creating a new summary.
partialAnalysis: This summary covers only part of what was read. Narrow the dates to include more.
coverage: {included} of {collected} commits included · {prs} matched PR descriptions.
attribution: Based on commit messages and PR descriptions. Atlas has not checked their claims about behavior or tests.
reasonMissing: The included descriptions do not state a reason.
checksMissing: The included descriptions do not state which checks ran.
limitsMissing: The included descriptions do not state remaining limits. This is not evidence that none remain.
excluded: {count} commits or PRs were not included in this summary.
sourceUnavailableInline: This text could not be read in full, so the summary cannot use it. Other commits and PRs are still readable.
ontologyNote: Concepts as recorded now. They do not shape the summary or prove how the code behaved before.
prSnapshotNote: The PR description as read now, which may differ from what it said when merged.
remoteSelection: Choose the public GitHub repository whose PR descriptions you want to read.
unexplained: {count} commits or PRs were sent but not summarized. Read them alongside this partial summary.
sourceAudit: Connection checks and summary requests are logged in Atlas app data on this device. The log holds where and how much was sent, not the repository text.
overviewIntro: Collect the changes, reasons and open problems written in commits and PRs.
preparing: Checking the model and preparing the preview…
readPrHelp: PR descriptions add the reasons and checks that merge commit messages leave out.
readPeriodCode: Show code changes for the whole period
claimsNote: Based on what the authors wrote · open a source to check it.
prCancelled: PR reading stopped. Commits and dates are kept.
rejectedResponseNote: This response did not match its sources, so it was not used as a summary. It is kept in memory on this screen only and is not saved to disk.
incompleteAnalysis: The summary was too long to finish. Your dates are kept. Narrow the dates and try again.
recordingGaps: For anything missing here, check the commits and PRs themselves. A missing item does not mean no problems remain.
languageMismatch: The model did not answer in the screen language. Your dates are kept; try again.
checksOriginal: Checks are quoted as the authors wrote them.
periodPlan: Sends {commits} commit messages and {prs} PR descriptions in {parts} requests, one at a time.
periodReadingBytes: These requests send {bytes} bytes in total.
periodOverviewPlan: One last request sends up to {bytes} bytes of selected passages to write the overall summary.
periodSinglePart: This period fits in one request. Its summary is the overall summary.
periodSessionOnly: Summaries and progress clear when you close Atlas.
periodUnsendable: {count} commits or PRs cannot be sent. See why below; the rest stay in the plan.
periodStopping: Stopping the current request. Finished parts stay available.
periodStopped: Stopped after {completed} of {parts} parts. Finished summaries are kept; continue to do the rest.
periodPartFailed: Part {number} failed. Finished parts and your dates are kept. Retry this part to continue.
periodSynthesizing: Writing the overall summary from selected passages…
periodOverviewFailed: The overall summary failed. Part summaries are still available. Retry the overall summary only, or read the parts.
periodOverviewCoverage: Overall summary request: {selected} of {candidates} passages · {represented} of {parts} parts included.
periodOverviewPartial: Some passages did not fit in the overall summary. Read the part summaries for the rest of the work and the limits the authors noted.
periodCoverage: {completed} of {parts} parts done · {sent} of {collected} commits and PRs sent · {linked} cited in part summaries.
periodGaps: {unexplained} sent but not summarized · {unsent} not sent · {uncertain} not confirmed as delivered. Sending an item does not mean it was fully summarized.
periodFinished: All parts are done. Check coverage and the commits and PRs for anything left out.
periodPartial: This summary is partial: some history, PR lookups, commits or summaries are missing. See Coverage for details.
periodOverviewSelection: Review passages for the overall summary
periodOverlarge: This item is larger than the request limit, so it was not sent. Read it directly.
periodIncomplete: This item could not be read in full, so it was not sent. Refresh, or read what is available.
periodUnexplained: Sent, but not cited in any part summary. Read it directly.
periodStale: The commits, period, model, model limit or screen language changed. Finished parts keep their old settings. Prepare a new plan to continue.
periodNoOverview: The part summaries had nothing the overall summary could cite. Read the commits and PRs, or choose another period.
periodOverviewPolicy: The overall summary takes one change passage per part first, then noted limits, reasons, other changes and checks. Passages that do not fit are listed below.
periodOverviewOmitted: Over the overall summary request limit
prSavedPolicy: Atlas saves the public PR descriptions you read on this device: one version per PR, up to 400 or 16 MiB, oldest removed first. The PR text and repository visibility may have changed on GitHub since. You can delete all saved PR descriptions below.
prSavedLoading: Checking saved PR descriptions on this device…
prSavedNone: No saved PR descriptions for this period.
prSavedReady: Opened {count} saved PR descriptions. GitHub has not been checked for newer versions.
prSessionVersion: Kept until you close the app · read {fetchedAt}
prSavedUnchecked: PRs for {count} commits were not checked this time. Saved descriptions are not a full PR lookup.
prSavedOmitted: {count} more saved PR descriptions match this period but are over the read limit. Narrow the dates to open them.
prSavedIgnored: {count} saved PR descriptions failed a local check and were not opened. Read them from GitHub again to replace them.
prSavedUnavailable: Could not open saved PR descriptions safely. Read this period from GitHub again, or delete the saved descriptions and try again.
prSavedUnsupported: Saving PR descriptions is not available on this system. You can read GitHub now; the descriptions last until you close the app.
prSavedSaving: Saving PR descriptions on this device…
prSavedUpdated: Saved {count} PR descriptions on this device. Choose the same repository and period after restarting Atlas to open them again.
prSaveFailed: Could not update saved PR descriptions. What you read now stays until you close the app; older saved versions may come back after a restart. Check storage access, then read GitHub again or delete the saved descriptions.
prSaveTooLarge: {count} PR descriptions are over the save limit. They stay until you close the app; read GitHub again to get them later.
prSavedEvicted: Deleted {count} older saved PR descriptions to stay within the storage limit. Read GitHub again if you need them.
prSavedClearScope: Deletes saved PR descriptions for every repository on this device. What is open stays until you close the app; repositories, ontology folders and transfer logs are not changed.
prSavedCleared: Saved PR descriptions deleted. What is open stays until you close the app. Reading from GitHub again saves them again.
prClearFailed: Could not delete all saved PR descriptions. Some may remain on this device. Check storage access, then try again.
prSavedNotice: PR descriptions you read are saved on this device (up to 400 / 16 MiB).
prSaveSuperseded: A newer PR read or delete started. What is open stays until you close the app; saved descriptions were not replaced.
summaryEmptyBody: Read the commits and PRs, or create a summary.
summaryModelMissing: Choose a local model to create a summary. You can read the commits and PRs now.
summaryStale: Summary from earlier commits or settings
savedPrStatus: Saved PRs · not checked against GitHub
originalsDisclaimer: Written by authors · behavior not checked
previewSourceCount: {commits, plural, one {# commit message} other {# commit messages}} · {prs, plural, one {# PR description} other {# PR descriptions}}
previewSourceScope: Commit hashes, PR numbers and dates are included. Code and ontology documents are not sent.
previewOverview: Sends in parts, then up to {bytes} bytes of selected passages for the overall summary.
startBody: Open a local Git repository to see what was merged, grouped and counted.
